publication_scope: Completed observed records; independent narrative review is separate from tool and grading evidence.

public_environment_reporting.environment_field: Coordinator-confirmed OS family; normalized for publication, not a verbatim raw platform string.
public_environment_reporting.retained: Go, client, model and Docker versions needed to interpret the runs; statuses, counts, phase clocks and original evidence digests.
public_environment_reporting.private_evidence: Original run manifests, workspaces and logs remain private and unchanged.

public_usage_reporting.monetary_estimates: Provider-reported monetary fields are intentionally omitted from publication, including null placeholders.
public_usage_reporting.token_counts: Provider-reported token counts are retained without converting them to prices or personal spending.
public_usage_reporting.other_evidence: Statuses, counts, timings, versions and original evidence digests are unchanged; private originals remain intact.
